summary: Fixed test-zotero-generate-export.sh's quadratic synthesize_citekeys() loop, which hung every verify-deploy.sh run, by rewriting it as a single bulk jq pass and adding a bounded wall-clock timeout with a proof-of-fire scenario. All 4 plan phases are complete: the suite now runs 13/13 pass in ~12s (was an indefinite hang), and both run-all.sh (~28m34s) and the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set (~23m50s) now terminate with a definite result instead of hanging. Phase 4 closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS against 4 pre-existing gate failures, none related to this task, each recorded with reason and evidence in the plan's Reasoned Exclusions table.
